visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a vertical split-screen format. The top half is labeled with white text at the top and shows a bright, sunlit baseball stadium with ads on the outfield wall. A man in a leopard-print baseball jersey and sunglasses stands with arms open as a woman in a leopard-print bikini and short black skirt approaches him. The bottom half shows a dark stadium at night with a large holographic net screen displaying human silhouettes. (2) In the top frame, the man grabs the woman by her waist and lifts her, beginning a 360-degree rotation. She extends her legs and performs a backbend as he spins her. In the bottom frame, the holographic figures perform a synchronized dance move where the male silhouette appears to lift and spin the female silhouette on the screen. (3) The man in the top frame completes the spin and sets the woman back on her feet on the dirt infield. She smiles and laughs while a catcher in full protective gear stands in the background. The bottom frame's projection continues with glowing red and white light effects outlining the virtual performance.
